metadata.title: नए सफ़र के कुछ यादगार पल | A few moments from our new Journey | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Here we are sharing a few memorable moments of our new journey in #adivasi_Bharat. In the last 6 months we have met different adivasi groups of Gujrat, Jharkhand, Chattisgarh, and Odisha.
